name: conduit
description: Coordinate AI agents and development resources through Conduit's authenticated remote MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agents, tasks, tools, and shared development context
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT, Codex, and other compatible agents to one authenticated Conduit MCP endpoint for shared agent identity, project context, resource discovery, task coordination, atomic claims, ownership-safe handoffs, and auditable activity history.
defaultPrompt: Use Conduit to coordinate agents, tasks, resources, and shared development context.
Register this agent with Conduit and inspect the current coordination context.
Create, claim, complete, or hand off a Conduit task without impersonating another agent.
